decisions.reason: The piezo inkjet printer is in an early stage with unresolved technical and market uncertainty, so the firm keeps the option open while the cost of holding it is low.
The software module is a low-cost, modular option that can be maintained while uncertainty about demand for variable-data inline printing resolves.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces remains an uncertain but potentially valuable option, and there is no evidence yet that its value is unlikely.
